summary: This Form 6-K filing by Foremost Clean Energy Ltd. (NASDAQ: FMST) attaches a press release inviting investors to a live webinar and Q&A session on June 3, 2026. The webinar, hosted by RedChip Companies, features President and CEO Jason Barnard providing updates on the company's uranium exploration activities in the Athabasca Basin, its strategic partnership with Denison Mines, and broader uranium market trends. The filing contains no material corporate transaction, no new event triggering a special situation—it is purely an investor relations announcement. As such, it does not qualify as a special-situation filing.
